_note: v2.8 plan 60 B5 (no-model lane WITH server plugins, claude offered in the copy's harness config; spends one tiny call on the owner's Claude login): a plain harness call asked for the alias 'haiku' answers ok with `model` = the model Claude reports it served (a full claude-haiku id, not the alias) and `requested` = 'haiku'. codex and opencode are not offered on this lane (owed). Run on a lane started with plugins: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-60-b5-harness-model.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const base = '/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-harness'; const status = await fetch(base + '/status', { headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders() }).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).catch(() => null); const claude = status?.harnesses?.claude; if (!claude?.offered || !claude?.installed) throw new Error('claude is not offered on this lane: ' + JSON.stringify(claude ?? status)); if (!claude.fresh) throw new Error('the claude login is not fresh: ' + claude.loginProblem); const requestId = 'so-b5-' + Date.now().toString(36); const body = JSON.stringify({ requestId, harness: 'claude', model: 'haiku', role: 'memory', system: 'Answer plainly.', prompt: 'Reply with exactly the word: PONG', timeoutMs: 120000, maxOutputChars: 200 }); const started = Date.now(); const response = await fetch(base + '/complete', { method: 'POST', headers: { ...ctx.getRequestHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=UTF-8', 'X-SO-Plugin': '1' }, body }); const data = await response.json(); const ms = Date.now() - started; if (data?.ok !== true) throw new Error('the harness call failed: ' + JSON.stringify(data).slice(0, 400)); if (!/PONG/i.test(String(data.text ?? ''))) throw new Error('unexpected text: ' + data.text); if (data.requested !== 'haiku') throw new Error('requested is not the asked id: ' + JSON.stringify(data.requested)); if (typeof data.model !== 'string' || !/^claude-.*haiku/i.test(data.model)) throw new Error('model is not the served claude-haiku id: ' + JSON.stringify(data.model)); return { ok: true, requested: data.requested, model: data.model, finish: data.finish ?? null, ms };
